implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.move(dx,dy) validates and updates position; main.py maps LEFT/RIGHT keys to game.move(-1,0) / game.move(1,0).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player can rotate pieces before they land
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.rotate() attempts a clockwise rotation with wall‑kick offsets; main.py maps UP key to game.rotate().
Board.clear_lines() removes fully occupied rows; Game.lock_current() calls clear_lines() after locking a piece.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when no more pieces can be placed
